title: Disclose MSBuild diagnostic I/O inside the index writer transaction
outcome: Disclose MSBuild diagnostic I/O inside the index writer transaction
acceptance: Any claim about slowdown magnitude or cancellation causality is supported by measurement, not inferred from count-based evaluator budgets or an aborted record.

README and design documentation explicitly state that enabled diagnostic appends occur inside the index writer transaction, can prolong the writer hold, and should be disabled after reproduction; alternatively a reviewed implementation moves flushing outside that transaction without changing diagnostic/result semantics.
